summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 are partially implemented via code/styling updates (new hero image path used on the homepage; app-wide background class and CSS pseudo-element added). However, the diff shows no new static asset files added, so the requirement to add the uploaded images as frontend static assets is not evidenced. Several additional unrequested visual/theme changes were also introduced (palette/animations/nav styling).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the uploaded “Cool Kidz Club” image as a static frontend asset and use it as the hero image on the Clubhouse home page (replacing the current hero image).
missing_requirements.reason: The homepage hero image reference was updated to the new file path, but the diff shows no added asset file; requirement explicitly includes adding the uploaded image as a static frontend asset.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the uploaded “colorful handprints” image as a static frontend asset and apply it as the background across the app (at least for the main app shell/pages), ensuring foreground content remains readable.
missing_requirements.reason: Background styling references the new image path and is applied via AppShell, but the diff shows no added asset file; requirement explicitly includes adding the uploaded image as a static frontend asset.

hallucinated_features.description: Global theme/palette changes ("Warm sunny palette") beyond the requested hero/background image swap.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is for frontend-only asset/styling changes specific to hero image and background; it does not request a broader color system overhaul.
evidence: frontend/src/index.css (multiple CSS variables changed for background/foreground/card/primary/secondary/accent, etc.)
